standard_prerequisites.use: The Kunneth injectivity for H^1 of O on a product of proper schemes over a field (Varieties), and the chapter's relative-Picard lemma promoting fibrewise triviality plus an injectivity condition on H^1(O) to local triviality; cited inputs with the composition written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Apply the Kunneth lemma to get injectivity of H^1 of O on the fibre product into the direct sum over the factors.
Verify the hypotheses of the multiple-section Picard flat proper lemma for the two morphisms 1 x tau and sigma x 1.
Conclude local triviality of L over a neighbourhood of s.

proof_roadmap.step: Extract the Kunneth injectivity on the special fibre.
Feed it into the multiple-Picard lemma along the two sections to conclude.

difficulty_reason: In the relative-Picard setup (proper, flat, finitely presented morphisms f : X -> S and g : Y -> S with sections sigma, tau), an invertible sheaf L on X x_S Y whose pullbacks along 1 x tau and sigma x 1 and whose restriction to the fibre over s are trivial becomes trivial over the whole product after shrinking S around s. The retained proof is a written two-input argument: the Kunneth lemma for the fibre product makes H^1(X_s x Y_s, O) -> H^1(X_s, O) (+) H^1(Y_s, O) injective, which is precisely the hypothesis needed to apply the multi-Picard lemma (lemma-H1-O-multiple-picard-flat-proper) to the two morphisms 1 x tau and sigma x 1, and the conclusion follows. Retained author proof at lines 9634-9650.
